scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run gen && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run gen && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run gen && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run gen && tsc -b && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
